Remaining trigger: root exists but returns an empty or partial listing without errors (network share glitch, emptied mount point). Phase 1 tests should target that, keep 'drive absent' as a regression test. items.title: Limiter reads sample peaks only; inter-sample peaks exceed 0 dBTP
items.evidence: limiter.rs:80 peak = max |x| over the frame; no oversampling in the limiter. True peak exists only in loudness.rs (measurement). items.notes: Python copy is my own re-implementation; measure the same signals on the real Rust code.
